title: Every change is checked whole before it is saved
statement: Every change any domain makes MUST go through one command runner, one write at a time on the state the one before it left, in one transaction held to every aggregate's rules and the schema's keys, constraints and validation queries, and MUST be saved whole or not at all: refused, it names every problem with its rule and the table, row and value (a loaded row's data file and line, or the index of the command that brought it) and leaves every data file as it was; accepted, it rewrites only the data files of the tables it changed, each through a temporary file and a rename, rows sorted by key and columns in the table's order; and a crash in the middle of a write leaves the data as it was or as the change meant.

title: Every load reads the product it is given, and only its schema
statement: Every load MUST read a product's records from the data folder its config names, MUST refuse a config it does not know or written for another schema version, saying what to do, and MUST hold the records to the schema's keys and rules before any domain reads them: every required column of a kind with a value of its type and no column its table lacks, and a record's parts read back as rows of their own table, in position order. Older data moves forward only through the converters, one version at a time.

title: A change to a data file reaches every open view
statement: Whenever a product's data files change, by a command, the Owner in an editor, a merge or a checkout, every open view MUST be told at once and read the data again, and MUST be told again when the checks' run that follows is ready.

title: Every interface reads and writes through one contract
statement: The web app, the desktop app, the command line, the agent tools and the package's exports MUST send every write and read through one contract: each names the one command or query it runs (`lathe <aggregate> <command>`, the `<aggregate>_<command>` tool, its route or its exported function), taking that command's own fields checked against their columns and never a table or kind to dispatch by, no two sharing a name on any interface; a refusal MUST reach the sender with every reason and its rule (printed with an error exit, returned as data, answered 422 or thrown), and asking a query MUST change no record and no data file. A device that may only read MUST be refused every write.

title: The desktop app gives each product folder one window of its own
statement: The desktop app MUST run once per machine, open each product folder in one window of its own, reopen its windows from its own saved state, and give its page nothing of the machine but the one bridge it names.

title: Every package is built and proved the same way
statement: Every package MUST be compiled with the same strict checks, keep no unused file, export or dependency, merge its data files record by record, and run its stability, accessibility and phone suites against one built app, with the number of test workers capped.
